method.scope: New no-paid cross-domain exploration; previous run preserved
method.selection: Inspect at most three implementation repositories from these pools; prioritize a source-owned operation addressing the fixed target's hypothesis/admission or observability limits. No requirement for directly integrable code; no popularity-as-fit criterion.

selection_reason: Inspect a deferred-hypothesis tracker, continuous/discrete graphical inference, and functional rather than full-state observability. These operations, not RF vocabulary or popularity, drive source inspection.
